statement.text:
Let U (K) denote the group of units of a ring K. Let G be a finite group, ZG
the integral group ring of G, and Zp G the group ring of G over the residues modulo
a prime number p. Describe the homomorphism from U (ZG) into U (Zp G) induced
by reducing the coefficients modulo p. More precisely, find the kernel and the image
of this homomorphism and an explicit transversal over the kernel.        R. Zh. Aleev
